# ubiops_role_assignment (Resource)

Manages a UbiOps role assignment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ubiops_role_assignment" "example" {
  project_name  = "my-project"
  role          = "project-admin"
  assignee      = ubiops_service_user.example.id
  assignee_type = "service_user"
  resource      = "my-project"
  resource_type = "project"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assignee` (String) UUID of the user or the name of the object
- `assignee_type` (String) Type of the assignee
- `project_name` (String) The name of the project.
- `role` (String) Name of the role assigned to the user/object

### Optional

- `resource` (String) Name of the object for which the role is assigned
- `resource_type` (String) Type of the object for which the role is assigned

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the role assignment (UUID)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ubiops_role_assignment.example my-project/assignment-uuid
```
